name: due-process-complaint
description: The Due Process Complaint Writer: a free Claude plugin that writes special education due process complaints (IDEA) from school documents, with every fact checked against them.

plugins.name: due-process-complaint
plugins.description: Writes a special education due process complaint (IDEA) from a child's IEP and school documents — evaluations, prior written notices, progress reports, service logs, emails — for any US state, in Claude Chat, Cowork or Claude Code: facts confirmed with the person filing, the state's filing rules looked up on its official pages, every date, figure and quotation checked against the documents, delivered as a PDF to file and a Word file to edit.
